statements.impact_statement: Lightning 2.6.6 contains the upstream d710d689510d50e800f53b3cd773cbca20b1f86f checkpoint-instantiator fix. The September 19 Trivy database incorrectly reports a fixed version of 2022.6.15. Acceptance requires scripts/check_lightning_patch.py against the scanned image: exact package version, exact patched source SHA-256 and rejection of an untrusted checkpoint instantiator. Other packages, versions and advisories remain blocking. Source: https://github.com/Lightning-AI/pytorch-lightning/commit/d710d689510d50e800f53b3cd773cbca20b1f86f
